mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is any arrangement of a set of objects in a definite order.
A permutation is any arrangement of a set of objects in a definite order.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a selection of n distinct objects without regard to order.
A combination is a selection of n distinct objects without regard to order.
Fill in the blank: ______ is the kinetic energy of electrons in the highest occupied state.
The Fermi energy is the kinetic energy of electrons in the highest occupied state.
fib: ______ is a measure of the number of states accessible to the system at a given temperature.
The partition function is a measure of the number of states accessible to the system at a given temperature.
______ are the protons and neutrons in nuclear matter, electrons in white dwarf stars. 3He, etc.
Examples are the protons and neutrons in nuclear matter, electrons in white dwarf stars. 3He, etc.
______ is a possible outcome in a random experiment.
An event is a possible outcome in a random experiment.
